newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Independent extends W&H offer.
newsitem.headline: Independent extends W&H offer.

text.p: Independent Newspapers Plc on Wednesday said it had extended its written offer for New Zealand publisher Wilson and Horton by one week to November 15.
The offer was previously due to expire on Friday.
Independent is offering NZ$11/share for all Wilson and Horton shares.
Independent Press Communcations, INP's bidding vehicle, said in a statement that INP now held more than 70 percent of Wilson and Horton.

"We have noticed an accelerating trend in acceptances, and it is for this reason that we have extended the written offer for a short period ensuring all shareholders have the opportunity to accept," IPCL said.
"A large number of enquiries continue to be received."

IPCL is also offering 1.375 exchangeable INP shares for each Wilson and Horton share. The exchangeable shares would be listed on the New Zealand stock exchange from Monday, November 11, at 9.30 a.m. (2030 GMT Sunday).
